welcome.headline: Bring multiple AI platforms into one creative workspace
welcome.description: We'll choose a primary provider, store its key securely, and prepare your first image task. Every step is optional and can be reopened from Settings.

features.models: Use image, video, and audio models in one place
features.canvas: Create quickly in Generate, then compose workflows on Canvas
features.local: Projects and preferences stay local; API keys use secure system storage

basics.headline: Confirm two basics
basics.description: Language changes immediately. The desktop app has already prepared a data directory that can be migrated later in Settings.
basics.dataDescription: Generation history, projects, and download settings use the app data directory. No path selection is needed during first launch.

provider.headline: Choose a primary provider
provider.description: This only decides which platform your first task prefers. Other models remain available, and you can change it at any time.
provider.more: ModelScope, Model Studio, and Volcengine Ark can still be configured under Provider Keys.

kie.name: KIE
kie.description: Broad coverage of new image and video models in one place—good for getting started quickly.

fal.name: Fal.ai
fal.description: A rich first-party model ecosystem with clear endpoints and fine-grained parameters.

apimart.name: APIMart
apimart.description: A unified API with detailed model metadata for cross-model workflows.

ppio.name: PPIO
ppio.description: Good regional connectivity for common models and latency-sensitive work.

apiKey.headline: Securely save your {{provider}} key
apiKey.description: Electron safeStorage encrypts the key locally. It is never written to projects, regular settings, or logs.
apiKey.configured: A saved key was found on this device. You can test it or replace it.
apiKey.testNote: Connection tests only use read-only balance or model-list endpoints. They never create a generation task or incur model charges.

results.saved_unverified: Saved securely; this provider has no confirmed no-charge verification endpoint
results.invalid_key: Authentication failed. Check whether the key is complete or revoked
results.insufficient_balance: The key is valid, but the balance is insufficient
results.rate_limited: The key is valid, but requests are currently rate-limited
results.timeout: The connection timed out. Check your network and try again
results.network_error: Could not connect. Check your network or proxy settings
results.service_error: The provider returned a service error. Try again later

firstTask.headline: Prepare your first real task
firstTask.description: We'll open Generate, select an image model from your primary provider, and insert an editable prompt. The model is called only after you click Generate.
firstTask.prompt: A warm bookstore on a rainy night, neon reflected in the window, cinematic composition, delicate lighting
firstTask.notReady: {{provider}} is not configured yet. You can still prepare the task; the app will ask for a key before generation.

coach.title: Your first task is ready
coach.description: Review the model and prompt, then click Generate. Onboarding completes automatically when a result returns.
coach.successDescription: Next, try another model, add a reference image, or continue the workflow on Canvas.

settings.description: Reopen the welcome flow or change the provider preferred for the first task. Saved keys are preserved.
